topic: Raising the insurance deductible to cut the premium vs auto-renewing (Desmond vs Priya)

scenes.narration: Same car, same coverage, two hundred forty dollars apart every single year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled AUTO RENEW and RAISE DEDUCTIBLE, comic burst banner reads TWO HUNDRED FORTY A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Desmond and Priya both pay eighteen hundred dollars yearly for car insurance.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man desmond and woman priya on training mats holding identical policy papers stamped EIGHTEEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both carry a five hundred dollar deductible and spotless driving records.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, desmond and priya at a gym whiteboard, two cards labeled FIVE HUNDRED DEDUCTIBLE and CLEAN RECORD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Desmond never opens the renewal notice. Same policy, same price, forever.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, desmond slumped on a gym bench dropping an unopened envelope labeled RENEWAL NOTICE into a bin, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He assumes insurance prices are fixed and calling changes absolutely nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, desmond shrugging beside a gym locker, a poster on the wall reads PRICES ARE FIXED with a big red question mark, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya calls her insurer and raises her deductible to one thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, priya on a phone in a gym office, a dial on the wall turning from FIVE HUNDRED to ONE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her premium drops two hundred forty dollars a year, same coverage.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, priya celebrating as a weight plate stamped TWO HUNDRED FORTY SAVED lifts off a barbell, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She parks that extra five hundred in savings for the deductible gap.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, priya sliding a stack of bills into a gym locker labeled DEDUCTIBLE FUND FIVE HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Five years later Desmond has paid twelve hundred extra for nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, tired desmond on a treadmill going nowhere, a scoreboard stamped TWELVE HUNDRED WASTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya saved sixteen hundred fifty and never filed a single claim.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, priya flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading SIXTEEN HUNDRED FIFTY SAVED, zero claims stamped on a clipboard, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her deductible fund covered a fender bender with cash to spare.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, priya calmly paying a repair bill from a jar labeled DEDUCTIBLE FUND, a dented bumper beside a gym door, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Raise your deductible only if savings already cover it. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading FUND IT FIRST THEN RAISE IT, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
